test_vectors: Empty models in both schema modes return both correctly named artifacts, explicit empty tables, exact zero schema count, generation notices, and one trailing LF
Declared aliases and inline nominal types from definitions, request fields, response fields, streams, and headers occur once in original bytewise name order without mutating the input
Qualified schema ordering model::Alpha, model::Header, model::StreamItem, model::Zulu, request::api.get, response::api.get yields exact ids 1 through 6

Canonical IR fingerprints match compiled headers and registry metadata; each emitted image reloads through the AOT facade with all projection tables, executable states, key tables, patterns, slots, policy, format options, and canonical schema preserved
Endpoint codes 0, 7, and u32::MAX sort numerically while canonical methods, declaration-order required roles, and independently sorted request/response schema ids remain exact
Dense field ids and slots preserve declaration order, optional absence semantics, u32/i32/i64 intrinsic bounds, timestamp bounds, float and Boolean mappings, and all supported string formats
Disabled schema tables skip unsupported projections, emit only the explicit zero count, and leave every optional schema id and fingerprint absent

Object, decimal, unit, nondefault NanoId lengths, vectors, nested optionals, nested records, and enums fail complete generation when used in any model/request/response candidate; dependency errors propagate unchanged

Duplicate endpoint codes, mismatched service ownership, unknown roles and references, alias cycles, nominal-name mismatches, duplicate field names, and injected service names propagate registry errors in both schema modes
Recursive nominal references terminate finite collection; reference aliases produce no extra schema candidate or fabricated schema provider identity
Invalid module names and configured ABI/AOT/derive paths fail before model processing and source interpolation
Configured crate paths appear verbatim in emitted tables; quote, backslash, LF, CR, tab, NUL, accented UTF-8, and emoji field bytes round trip as image data without source injection
Schema-id positions at zero, one, u32::MAX minus one, u32::MAX, and usize::MAX exercise checked conversion; metadata literals preserve zero and maximum fingerprints
Traversal depths zero and 127 succeed, while 128, 129, and usize::MAX fail with structured depth errors; duplicate internal catalog/candidate names and empty enums return constraint errors
Identical inputs produce identical program source; truncated images and corrupted image magic are rejected by the full program loader

The exact emitted lookup tokens are instantiated in tests for empty tables, static reference identity, case-sensitive byte ordering, absent names and codes, zero fingerprint, and maximum integer values
